contact_page.validation_rules: Client-side form validation with real-time feedback and local toast notification + interactive confirmation dialog upon submit.

component_guidelines.buttons: Use pill or crisp rounded-lg style with active states, focus rings, and explicit hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white). Never rely on color inheritance.
component_guidelines.cards: Subtle 1px border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800) with hover lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg on hover. Ensure internal padding p-6 or p-8.
component_guidelines.form_controls: Use custom Shadcn UI inputs, selects, and checkboxes styled to match StartupDesk emerald & slate palette. HTML native select is strictly disallowed.
component_guidelines.modals_and_drawers: Use Shadcn Dialog and Sheet with backdrop-blur-md for quick quote consultation drawers.
component_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for client feedback upon form submissions or quote calculations.

3d_and_motion_strategy.motion_rules: Micro-interactions on buttons, subtle scroll entrance staggers with opacity and y-offset (15px), and interactive financial charts for cost estimates.

accessibility_and_testing.data_test_id_convention: All interactive buttons, links, form inputs, route links, and key stats must include explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.
accessibility_and_testing.wcag_compliance: Normal text contrast ratio must exceed 4.5:1 against backgrounds. Focus states must feature outline-none ring-2 ring-emerald-500 ring-offset-2.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete multi-page React application for StartupDesk (startupdesk.ae) with React Router.

Implement all routes: Home (/), Services Catalog (/services), Service Details (/services/:id), Licenses Directory (/licenses), Cost Calculator (/cost-calculator), About (/about), and Contact (/contact).
Ensure client-side contact form validation with real-time error messages, local demo submission handling, and Sonner toast notification feedback.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements as detailed in the accessibility section.
Preserve the exact information architecture of zone10x.com while delivering a modernized, high-end StartupDesk B2B aesthetic.
